paper_title: Laboratory Constraints on the Neutron-Spin Coupling of feV-scale Axions
coupling_convention: g_aNN (neutron-spin coupling) in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis
notes: K-3He co-magnetometer reanalysis (Princeton data, ~40 days) searching for feV-scale axion neutron-spin coupling. Median 95% upper limit g_aNN < 2.4e-10 GeV^-1 for axion masses 0.4-4 feV (best 2.4e-10 at 0.36 Hz). Coupling is the derivative interaction g_aNN (GeV^-1) from L=g_aNN N-bar gamma^mu gamma^5 N d_mu a, NOT the dimensionless g_an; downstream may need conversion via g_an = 2 m_N g_aNN. Assumes local DM entirely axions but no numeric density stated. Full plot spans 0.01-10 Hz (~0.04-40 feV) but flat main result quoted for 0.4-4 feV; encoded as horizontal line.
